requirementSections.heading: Supporting Courses and Related Areas

rules.commentRaw: Demonstrate 12th-credit-level proficiency in one world language by coursework or examination
Students must complete 12 credits as participants in an approved Penn State Education Abroad Program, no more than 6 credits of which may be world language study beyond the 12-credit level
Select 6 credits (400 level) related to the education abroad experience, or the student's major, or complete a thematic concentration
